narration.reasoning: The relayer calls execTransaction on the Safe (c0, c1), which verifies signatures and calls approve(spender=0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3, value=2500000000) on USDC (c4). USDC proxies to implementation (c5) updating allowance in storage slot s0 and emitting an Approval event (e1). Safe increments its nonce (s1) and emits ExecutionSuccess (e0).

effects.sentence: The Safe increments its transaction nonce from 1 to 2.
The Safe grants Ravi an allowance of 2,500 USDC.
